notes.title: OVERCLOCKED UPDATE
notes.content:
Enemy tweaks
New Boss
More Weapons
More Power ups
Updated graphics
New Quick Dash/Dodge
Vehicle Removed and Replaced with Body (Feels more immersive)
Truncated "Lite Dungeon" mode: 3 floors(1 per environment) then Final Boss. For quick runs.
Floor Clear rewards: Choose a stat to boost. Health, Energy Recovery, or Rate of Fire.
More performance optimizations and bug fixes.
Smooth Rotation turn speed configurable
Smooth Movement player speed configurable
Teleportation as an option
DLSS3/FSR3/MSAA/TAA
